newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia wool trade sales up 52 percent -IWS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia wool trade sales up 52 percent -IWS.

text.p: Australian wool trade sales by end-September were up 52 percent against same period a year earlier, the International Wool Secretariat said on Tuesday.
Substantial quantities of wool -- as much as 19 million kg -- have already been shifted from the grower-held stockpile this season, the IWS said monthly market briefing.
The quantities represent about 18 percent of estimated private stocks held in Australia at the start of the season,
Global wool availability is forecast to rise four percent and apparel wool availability eight percent in 1996/97 due largely to release of private stocks in Australia, the IWS said.
The increases are undermining potential for higher raw wool prices given the "somewhat patchy pipeline and retail demand," the IWS said.
